allow: PowerShell($page = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/" -UseBasicParsing; "Status: $\($page.StatusCode\)"; "ContentLength: $\($page.Content.Length\)"; if \($page.Content -match 'BOOBArbitrage'\) { "Title found: BOOBArbitrage" } else { "WARN: Title not found in HTML" }; if \($page.Content -match 'Carry-to-Risk'\) { "CTR section: present" } else { "WARN: CTR section not in static HTML \(likely client-rendered\)" })

PowerShell($api = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/carry?symbol=SOL" -UseBasicParsing; "API status: $\($api.StatusCode\)"; $j = $api.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; "ctr=$\($j.ctr\) basis=$\($j.basis\) breakeven=$\($j.breakevenHours\) dataPoints=$\($j.dataPoints\)")
